subject: Joint booth + MDF terms for AI Summit SF 2025
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia@cloudbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Opportunity: co-sponsor booth + joint webinar at AI Summit SF 2025

Hi Sergio,

Hope you’re well — I’m Lydia on the partnerships team at CloudBridge. We’re securing co-sponsors for the AI Summit SF (Nov 11-12) and thought Redwood would be a great fit given the inference angle. High-level idea: shared 10x20 booth (split build + staffing), a 30-min joint breakout session on "Scaling LLMs in Production" and a short follow-up webinar in December to keep the pipeline warm.

Before we lock anything we need to confirm:
- MDF budget expectations from Redwood (standard co-sponsor packages range $8k–$15k)
- Lead-sharing rules and co-marketing assets timeline
- Any compliance constraints (no customer data sharing)

Can we set a quick call this week? If it helps, I can share our booth floorplan and standard MDF term sheet.

Best,
Lydia Park
Partnerships, CloudBridge
lydia@cloudbridge.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: co-sponsor booth + joint webinar at AI Summit SF 2025

Hi Lydia — thanks for reaching out, this sounds promising.

We’re interested in a co-sponsor arrangement and the webinar follow-up. Quick answers:
- MDF: we typically budget $10k–$15k for shared booths depending on net lead guarantees and branding (we can be flexible).
- Lead-sharing: Redwood requires SFDC ingestion and opt-in gating; we don’t exchange raw customer PII outside the lead flow.
- Compliance: we can’t accept any data that includes Redwood customer content; marketing assets are fine.

Looping in Camila to propose a promotional plan and to sync on deadlines. Can you also send the floorplan and term sheet you mentioned?

Sergio
Sr. Channel & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@cloudbridge.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-03T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: co-sponsor booth + joint webinar at AI Summit SF 2025

Thanks Lydia & Sergio — excited to explore. A few practical suggestions from Redwood marketing:

1) Booth ops / visibility
- 10x20 sounds right. If CloudBridge covers build costs, Redwood can commit to staffing and demo material.

2) Webinar + promo cadence
- Joint webinar: target the week of Dec 8; we’ll run paid social + email; suggest a co-branded landing page (we can host).
- Creative deadlines: final assets due Nov 1 for programmatic promos.

3) Lead handling
- We’ll accept HubSpot-formatted CSV exports or direct HubSpot webhooks into our partnership pipeline.

Marissa — can you confirm MDF availability and any contractual requirements (SOW/PO timeline)?

Camila Reyes
Partner Marketing, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: co-sponsor booth + joint webinar at AI Summit SF 2025

Camila — we can approve a conditional MDF of $12,500 for CloudBridge, subject to the following:
- Signed MDF term sheet (attached) outlining payment milestones (50% on signed SOW, 50% 30 days after event).
- Lead quality clause: minimum 150 MQLs attributable to joint activities or prorated clawback.
- Co-branding approvals: final creative must be approved 7 business days before deployment.

I’m attaching a draft term sheet for legal review. If CloudBridge accepts the conditions, finance will issue a PO within 5 business days of the signed MDF doc.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — that budget and the terms look workable. CloudBridge is happy to accept the $12,500 MDF and the lead minimum. A few notes from our side:
- CloudBridge will cover booth construction costs and will handle on-site logistics (power, AV, shipping).
- We request a 30% contribution toward booth collateral production (e.g., joint brochures) to be invoiced against the MDF.
- We’ll circulate a DocuSign link for the MDF term sheet and the event MOU this afternoon.

Attaching the floorplan so you can confirm the corner placement (we prefer an aisle-facing spot).

On Oct 5, 2025, at 16:47, Lydia Park <lydia@cloudbridge.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — that budget and the terms look workable. CloudBridge is happy to accept the $12,500 MDF and the lead minimum. A few notes from our side:
> - CloudBridge will cover booth construction costs and will handle on-site logistics (power, AV, shipping).
> - We request a 30% contribution toward booth collateral production (e.g., joint brochures) to be invoiced against the MDF.

Thanks — summarizing the mutual action plan so we have a single source of truth: 
1) MDF: Redwood to sign term sheet; CloudBridge receives $12,500 per the attached draft. Finance to issue PO once DocuSign is complete.
2) Booth ops: CloudBridge covers build; Redwood provides staffing & demo laptops. Co-pay on collateral: Redwood will allocate up to $3,750 (30% of MDF) toward shared collateral, invoiced against the MDF.
3) Lead sharing: CloudBridge to export HubSpot CSV within 48 hours post-event; Redwood will ingest to our partnership pipeline and honor the MQL gate.
4) Webinar: Target week of Dec 8 for the post-event webinar; Camila to own landing page and ad creative; creative approvals due by Nov 1.
5) Next actions:
   - Lydia to send DocuSign links today (CloudBridge) -> sign and return by Oct 9.
   - Marissa to route the signed MDF to Finance for PO generation.
   - Camila to create the shared Drive folder and invite CloudBridge marketing.

If everyone agrees, we’ll consider this plan effective upon signature. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if anything needs clarification.

Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Channel & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
